## Citation

Volaric, A.K.; Barrantes-Reynolds, R.; Sahakyan, K.; Fedoriw, Y.; Frietze, S. (2025). The EBV-Positive Tumor Methylome Is Distinct from EBV-Negative in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. *Cancers*, 14(2), 299.

## Abstract

This study investigates the epigenetic landscape of EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), comparing methylation patterns between EBV-positive and EBV-negative cases. The analysis reveals distinct methylome signatures that may contribute to disease pathogenesis and suggest therapeutic targets.

## Key Findings

- EBV-positive DLBCLs show a distinct methylation profile compared to EBV-negative cases
- Specific genomic regions show differential methylation associated with viral status
- Epigenetic patterns correlate with known oncogenic pathways in lymphoma
- Results suggest potential biomarkers for patient stratification and treatment selection

## Role

As a co-author on this publication, I contributed bioinformatics analysis of methylation data and interpretation of genomic patterns.
